title: Kenneth Arnold's 1947 craft matched Horten design

tellings.quote: kind that that Kenneth uh um Arnold saw you know in 1947. The same design without him knowing at the time

related.note: Same 1947 Kenneth Arnold sighting, but this telling claims the craft matched the Horten brothers' design, which recasts the object as a human-built craft.

plain: The objects a pilot named Kenneth Arnold reported seeing in the sky in 1947 had the same design as a craft built by the Horten brothers, German aircraft designers, though Arnold did not know it at the time. That is how the researcher Peter Levenda puts it to Michels, without naming a source. If true, Arnold's famous sighting would point to a human design rather than something unknown.
